comment: Every case renders the tiles around lat/lon (radius tiles in every direction) for every zoom
of 'zooms' or of the 'minzoom'..'maxzoom' range and compares the water mask with the
reference raster tile. 'maps' are the obf files the case needs - they are downloaded from
https://download.osmand.net/list into -maps.dir when they are missing.
check: 'water' compares the water masks, 'seamarksInland' renders the maps of 'maps' alone
and requires the tile to stay empty.
The 'Ocean rendered as land' tiles carry no 'maps': they are open ocean far from any detailed
map and are drawn from the basemap alone. The z3-z5 ones were found by -scan -minzoom=1
-maxzoom=5 over the whole world, where the whole tile comes out as land while the reference is
all water; the z7-z10 ones are Tuamotu atolls cut by the tile edge (Tematangi, Kauehi).
brokenReferences are areas where the reference itself is wrong: every tile from 'minzoom' on
that touches 'bbox' is compared with tile.openstreetmap.org instead, by the cases, the random
tiles and the scan alike. dataIssues are areas where the OSM data is wrong: their tiles are skipped.
A failed tile is always compared with tile.openstreetmap.org once more, and counted as a stale
reference when that one agrees with the rendered tile.

brokenReferences.title: Island at 63.709, -72.477 (way 1528910723)
brokenReferences.reason: The reference is drawn from water polygons older than the island (mapped 2026-06-12): straight land edges, 84% agreement with OSM against 99% of ours. Re-rendering does not help.

dataIssues.title: Islands near Postoyanny, 72.1, 146.1 (ways 1185693443-1185693448)
dataIssues.reason: Real islands (checked on imagery) mapped as place=island without natural=coastline: OsmAnd fills place=island as land, openstreetmap-carto does not draw them at all.

dataIssues.title: Lagoon of St. Lawrence Island at 63.58, -171.09
dataIssues.reason: The place=island area of the island covers its lagoon, which is sea by the coastline: OsmAnd fills it as land, openstreetmap-carto does not fill place=island.

dataIssues.title: Straits of Bely Island at 73.38, 70.2 (relation 1867826)
dataIssues.reason: The place=island multipolygon joins two islets to Bely Island with untagged ways 270259332, 270259333, 270259335 across the water: OsmAnd fills the straits as land, openstreetmap-carto does not fill place=island.

dataIssues.title: Nonouti lagoon, -0.6, 174.35 (relation 4036870)
dataIssues.reason: The whole atoll with its lagoon is mapped as one place=islet multipolygon (Tabukaokao, reef=coral): OsmAnd fills the lagoon as land, openstreetmap-carto does not fill place=islet.

dataIssues.title: Clipperton lagoon, 10.3, -109.22 (way 160415456)
dataIssues.reason: The closed coastline of the atoll is also tagged place=island, so the island area covers the lagoon (relation 5883538, natural=water): OsmAnd fills it as land, openstreetmap-carto does not fill place=island.
